# UML 2.5.1 to UML3 (SysML v2) traceability

<!-- GENERATED by tools/check_traceability.py from traceability/uml2-to-uml3.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

This document traces each UML 2.x concept to how **UML3** realizes it on SysML v2 and KerML. UML3 is not a copy of UML 2.x. Where a native SysML v2 element already covers a concept it is **used as-is, without a UML3 label** (e.g. `action def` for Activity/Behavior), and this map records that decision explicitly. Every cited metaclass, UML3 element, view definition and example snippet is verified by the test suite.

## Status legend

* **NATIVE**: SysML v2 / KerML element used as-is; UML3 adds nothing
* **NATIVE+UML3**: native SysML v2 element, optionally refined by a UML3 keyword or library element
* **UML3**: realized by a UML3 library element or keyword
* **PARTIAL**: covered with a different structure or reduced scope (see notes)
* **NOT_ADOPTED**: deliberately not carried into UML3 (see rationale)

## Summary

|---|---|

| NATIVE+UML3 | 15 |
| UML3 | 14 |

| **Total** | **91** |
